Tyrannosaur_Crushing_Jaws.description: Enormous and terrifying, the Tyrannosaur's Crushing Jaws are a testament to raw, primal strength, capable of snapping steel and shattering bones with a single bite, while its mighty cephalon houses the brute force needed to deliver devastating blows that can sunder the mightiest of armors.

Raptor_Serrated_Snapping_Maw.description: Equipped with a razor-sharp, serrated maw, this cephalon is a marvel of predatory engineering, its agile and swift movements allowing it to strike with lethal precision, leaving foes bleeding and vulnerable.

Triceratops_Beaked_Maw.description: The Triceratops_Beaked_Maw is a fearsome cephalic appendage, bristling with serrated teeth and reinforced with thick, bony plates that provide formidable natural armor, capable of delivering crushing bites and sundering enemy defenses with brute force.

Crocodilian_Death_Roll_Jaws.description: Equipped with a maw capable of rending flesh and bone, the Crocodilian_Death_Roll_Jaws is a fearsome cephalon component that embodies raw saurian power, enhancing both physical might and resilience, and granting the wielder the terrifying prowess of a predator in both land and water.

Venomous_Spitting_Saurian_Maw.description: Equipped with a venomous spitting saurian maw, this fearsome cephalon combines lethal agility and toxic might, granting its bearer enhanced dexterity and constitution, along with the sinister skills to unleash a paralyzing bite and a choking poison cloud.

Spinosaurus_Piscivore_Snout.description: The Spinosaurus_Piscivore_Snout is a fearsome cephalic appendage, a deadly fusion of raw power and agility, with elongated, razor-sharp teeth designed for piercing and tearing flesh with unmatched precision and speed, granting its bearer enhanced dexterity and strength in the water and on land.

Pterosaur_Toothy_Beak.description: Equipped with a razor-sharp beak tipped with wickedly curved teeth, this pterosaur component enhances the wielder’s agility and speed, granting a fearsome bite that can tear through flesh with ease.

Herbivore_Grinding_Maw.description: Equipped with a colossal, serrated maw that spans the entire width of its skull, this herbivorous behemoth has evolved a terrifying adaptation that allows it to grind even the toughest plant matter into submission, its cranial bite adding a fearsome +2 to its constitution, a testament to the strength and durability of its grinding jaws.

Spectral_Saurian_Ghost_Jaws.description: Emerging from the shadows, the Spectral Saurian Ghost Jaws are a haunting presence with razor-sharp mandibles that shimmer with arcane energy, capable of delivering devastating bites imbued with dark magic, their very presence chilling the soul and leaving a trail of spectral dread in their wake.

Zombie_Trex_Rotting_Maw.description: The Zombie_Trex_Rotting_Maw, a towering undead abomination with a massive, putrid jaw lined with razor-sharp, diseased teeth, exudes an aura of toxicity and strength, its very presence a harbinger of decay and pain.
